Meanwhile, the third phase of a review of safety options for France's Nuward SMR has been started by eight European nuclear regulators.

articles.title: EDF seeking maximum use of existing UK reactors

The company said it plans to operate its last two Advanced Gas-cooled Reactors until at least 2030 and is seeking a 20-year licence extension for the Sizewell B pressurised water reactor.
